intent.description: feat | fix | chore | docs | refactor | security | other

supersedes.description: PR or issue numbers this change replaces. Required when changed paths overlap an open PR.

touches_contracts.description: Must be true when the diff touches contracts/, zen/contracts/, dex/registry.yaml, or .github/pr-intent.yaml

expiry_days.description: Stale-PR threshold. Default 14. CI/stale action labels at this age.
